newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore keeps '97 GDP growth forecast at 5-7 pct.
newsitem.headline: Singapore keeps '97 GDP growth forecast at 5-7 pct.

text.p: Singapore's official growth forecast for 1997 remains at five to seven percent, the Ministry of Trade and Industry said.
Singapore's Gross Domestic Product (GDP) grew seven percent in 1996.
Private economists' forecasts for Singapore GDP growth have ranged around seven percent while the Asian Development Bank recently forecast growth of some 7.5 to eight percent for the next two years.
